## History

Flora Jane is the daughter of Mrs. [Blewett](../character/blewett.md). She was mentioned by her mother when Mrs. [Blewett](../character/blewett.md) offered to take [Anne](../character/anne.md) in as a domestic helper, noting that Flora Jane was a dreadful handful.

## Relationships

### [Spencer](../character/spencer.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/flora-jane--spencer.md)

Flora Jane is the child of Mrs. [Spencer](../character/spencer.md). Her mother inadvertently arranges for [Anne](../character/anne.md) to be brought to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) instead of the boy [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) originally requested. During a visit to address the misunderstanding, Mrs. [Spencer](../character/spencer.md) attempts to resolve the situation by offering [Anne](../character/anne.md) to another neighbor, though Flora Jane herself plays no active role in the exchange.

- Child of  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P4](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0004)</sub>
